terra.problem: The psalm does not say David would be less worried if these people listened to one another.
The psalm does not say the people David describes are not singing.
The psalm records David's prayer but does not say whether he grabs anything himself.
The boast is about prevailing with their tongues. The psalm does not say they have no weapons or are betting everything on sounding smooth.
The joke about confidence Papa cannot bake with has no clear connection to the boast.
The psalm does not say the LORD's words in the next verse are an answer to the boasters.
The explanation identifies the LORD as the speaker after quoting His words as I, rather than before.
The LORD names the oppressed and needy as the cause for which He will arise. The psalm does not say He is not arising for the boastful.
The psalm compares the LORD's words to refined silver; it does not say that any silver put through a furnace has no impurities left.
David does not say the LORD will keep and guard them right where they are.
The verse says the LORD will keep and guard them, but it does not say He will stay with them.
The wicked wandering freely does not establish that nobody has been driven away.
